description: Pull quotes highlighted in the article
prompt: A list of 1-5 quote strings; at least two of them must be shorter than 80 characters when there are three or more.
notes: The schema defines an array with 1 to 5 strings. It applies a conditional constraint using if-then so that when there are 3 or more items, the contains and minContains keywords validate that at least two of them are shorter than 80 characters.
